title: Warp header
description: A white 64px top bar with a hairline under it: lowercase wordmark, uppercase mono menu items with small chevrons, a sign-in link, a citron 'book a demo' button and a solid ink button. It sticks to the top; once the first screen has scrolled by (desktop), the menu slides up and a brand-blue bar of bracket-keyed jump links with a white button slides down in its place. A 2px brand line along the bottom of the window grows with page scroll, and vertical margin notes sit at both window edges on wide screens.
notes: the menu-to-jump-bar swap and the progress line are CSS scroll-driven animations on the page scroll (scroll(root)); without support the plain menu stays and the line is hidden
the phone menu is a native <details> disclosure, so it works without JavaScript
margin notes only show from 1300px wide
